pagerduty-bot: [PAGER] HIGH - embeddings-service 503 surge in us-west-2 - ~25% requests failing, increased p95 latency. Pager: customer-impacting. PagerID: PD-4521

Carmen: seeing the alert. I'm primary for the night. picking this up.

ops-bot: Incident started: 2026-03-15T02:14:12Z. Auto-created channel #inc-PD-4521.

Ben: i'm here, secondary. quick status?

Carmen: current symptoms: embeddings API returning 503s from the inference-router -> gpu-pool-03. Error rate jumped ~02:12 UTC. Traffic spike + eviction signs in KV cache.

Alice: i'm pulling logs, looks like batcher memory OOMs and rpc timeouts to model-worker processes.

Carmen: good. initial mitigation plan: 1) failover traffic to dedicated embeddings capacity in us-east-1 2) scale up gpu-pool-03 3) enable degraded-mode (quantized smaller model) as fallback for embeddings endpoint.

Ben: I'll take failover and autoscale. Carmen you run degraded-mode toggle and monitor quality impact. Alice look at logs/runbook. Deepak keep an eye on customer pages and comms.

Deepak: copying. I'll DM PD list and prepare a short customer-impact note if we hit >30m.

Alice: runbook snippet (embeddings runbook):

```
# Embeddings 503 surge - quick steps
1. check cluster: kubectl get pods -n embeddings | grep CrashLoop
2. check allocator: /infra/allocations/gpu-pool-03
3. scale: terraform apply -var 'pool=gpu-pool-03' -target=module.autoscaler
4. failover: update route table to point embeddings-v2-dedicated-us-east
5. toggle fallback: POST /admin/feature-toggle {"embeddings:degraded_mode": true}
6. monitor: datadog dashboard -> embeddings.service.errors; set alert to 15%
```

Carmen: executing toggle now.

Carmen: `curl -X POST https://console.redwood.internal/admin/feature-toggle -d '{"embeddings:degraded_mode":true}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'` -> 200 OK. Degraded mode enabled.

Alice: logs show fewer OOM traces after toggle; still some 503s from older pods. Graphed error rate dropping from 25% -> ~12% in last 3m.

Ben: kicking failover route. `aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --change-batch file://failover.json` (applied). Confirmed traffic shift ~60% to us-east dedicated.

ops-bot: autoscaler event: scaling gpu-pool-03 from 4 -> 8 nodes (requested by Ben). Estimated add time ~4m.

Carmen: monitoring latency. p95 improved from 2.8s -> 1.4s for degraded path, overall p95 1.9s. 503s trending down.

Deepak: are there active customers seeing failures? PD dashboard shows 3 customer apps with increased error rates but none at full outage. sending quick status to customer-contacts now.

Deepak: message sent: "We observed elevated 503 errors for embeddings in us-west-2; we've enabled a degraded-mode fallback and failed over traffic to dedicated capacity. Error rates are decreasing. We're monitoring and will update in 30m."

Alice: checking pods - a subset of model-worker pods still crash on large batch sizes. Temporary workaround: reduce max-batch-size via config and restart batchers.

Carmen: applying reduced batch size (config: `max_batch_size: 8` -> previously 32) to router config. rolling restart router service.

Ben: autoscaler finished, new nodes joined pool. Memory headroom looks better. Good call on batch size.

Alice: after batch size change + degraded-mode + failover, 503s are now 2-3%. p95 stable ~1.2s. No new core dumps.

Carmen: marking incident as mitigated for now. still in monitoring. next steps: 1) keep degraded-mode for 30m post-stable 2) revert batch-size change via canary 3) postmortem iff recurrence or customer impact >30m

Ben: I'll keep primary watch for the next 45m, then hand to Deepak as primary at 03:15 UTC. Carmen you'll be secondary?

Carmen: yes i'll be secondary. Alice please keep logs/time-correlated traces for postmortem. Capture OOM stack traces and model-worker versions.

Alice: noted — collecting traces + saving `kubectl describe` outputs and logs to /incidents/PD-4521/artifacts.tar.gz

Deepak: prepping a short one-paragraph customer note for support ops.

ops-bot: Incident PD-4521 status: MITIGATED -> monitoring. Mitigation actions: degraded-mode, failover to dedicated, autoscaler scaled pool, reduced batch size.

Carmen: hooking runbook links: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-503 and internal playbook: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/embeddings-surge.

Ben: quick checklist for handoff in 45m: - confirm error rate <5% for 30m - confirm no CrashLoop or core dumps - confirm degraded_mode toggle logged with ticket - schedule follow-up diag session with infra and ML infra tomorrow 10:00 PT.

Deepak: will prepare the handoff bullet list and post to #eng-oncall 15m before pass.

Alice: saved artifacts and tracing. Leaving notes on the runbook with exact commands used.

Carmen: thanks team. I'll update PD ticket and close channel if stable after the watch window. :thumbsup:

Ben: good work. I'll watch the dashboards. :coffee:

Deepak: standby for customer comms updates.

pagerduty-bot: PD-4521 status changed to acknowledged by Carmen.

Carmen: last update at 03:20 UTC: error rate 2.1%, p95 1.15s, no new pages. will hand off at 03:59 UTC if stable.

Ben: copy.\/\/handoff planned.

---
Handoff summary (to paste into #eng-oncall):
- Incident PD-4521: embeddings 503 surge in us-west-2, started 02:14 UTC
- Mitigations applied: degraded-mode (smaller quantized model), failover to dedicated us-east capacity, autoscaler increased nodes, reduced router max_batch_size
- Current status: mitigated -> monitoring. error rate ~2%, p95 ~1.1s
- Action items: capture traces (Alice), postmortem if recurrence (Carmen/Ben), customer comms drafted (Deepak)
- Next primary: Ben (watch until 03:59 UTC), then Deepak

Participants for handoff: Carmen (primary initial), Ben (current primary), Deepak (next), Alice (logs/tracing).
